name: Rue des Gestes — étape 9 · balancer, se courber, rougir
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (girl swinging on the rope swing, man setting off a confetti cannon, old man bending to sniff his flowers on the balcony beside a wall mirror), -ir/-re RIGHT (shy young man blushing as a lady hands him a rose; door half-opening by itself with a cat peeking out, small mirror on the wall by it; baker rounding dough at the upper window). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
